WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
), shares AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         account_count,
         1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM district_counts
), differences AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         account_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT district_id,
       account_count,
       share,
       difference_from_average
FROM differences
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
